classificationPolicy.principle: Exactly one presentation category based on the primary recognizable earning path; mixed accolades use General when no single type dominates.
classificationPolicy.categoryChange: Task Forces / Strike Forces renamed to Task Forces / Strike Forces / Trials because six promoted accolades are explicitly earned through Respecification Trials.
classificationPolicy.historyBoundary: No current referenceKind=Accolade record is a History plaque-collection completion. Those identities remain promoted separately as referenceKind=HistoryPlaque and were not silently added to this 145-record dataset.
